notes.title: We are delighted to announce that the full version of our game is now over 70%
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone, I’m the developer of The Secret Story![/h1]

[h2]We are delighted to announce that the full version of our game is now over 70% complete! [/h2]

We are currently refining the storyline and integrating various narrative choices to make them more accessible and enjoyable for players who love decision-driven experiences. Despite being a small team with only one primary developer, we are working tirelessly to create a high-quality game. We hope to finish development and release the game ahead of schedule!

[b]Full Version Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] A variety of in-game puzzles for added fun and challenge
[*] Enhanced animation systems
[*] Improved UX/UI for a more engaging experience
[*] More diverse storylines based on different choices
[*] Expanded levels, increasing from 1 level in the demo to 6 levels in the full version
[/list]

We have now disabled downloads for the demo version because we are committed to improving the DEMO to make it even more enjoyable. For those who love story-driven games exploring beliefs, mysteries, and unique experiences,[u][b] feel free to Wishlist The Secret Story now![/b][/u]
[b]
Thank you for your support![/b]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3367740/The_Secret_Story/]Game Link[/url]

notes.title: The Secret Story First Demo Update
notes.content:
[h1]<Englist version>[/h1]

[b] Hello everyone, I’m the developer of The Secret Story! [/b]

Today, I’d like to share an update on the progress of the game’s development with all of you.

First of all, I’m excited to announce that we’ve uploaded [b][u] The Secret Story DEMO [/u][/b] version. It’s currently under review by the platform team and will be available for free as soon as possible.

[h1] You can download The Secret Story DEMO Free Play from our store page here: [/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3393910/The_Secret_Story_Demo_Free_Play/?beta=0

[h3] In this free-to-play demo, players will be able to experience: [/h3]

[list]
[*]A brief overview of our gameplay system
[*] Basic controls and mechanics
[*] Using interactive buttons to engage with objects and perform activities
[*] UX/UI menu adjustments
[*] A portion of the introductory storyline, which you can fully complete in the DEMO
[/list]

[b] If you enjoy story-driven games about beliefs, mysteries, and unusual experiences, we highly recommend downloading the demo to get a feel for the gameplay. [/b]

We apologize that the [b][u] DEMO Free to Play version [/u][/b] doesn’t contain extensive content yet. [b][u] Please don’t rush to conclusions or judgments! [/u][/b] The full version of the game will include a wealth of additional content and special features that you won’t want to miss.

[h3][b] Thank you for your support! [/b][/h3]
